name: Café Pension Marliesenhof
beschreibung: The Café Pension Marliesenhof is categorized as a charming hotel and guesthouse in Tirol. The on-site café serves delicious homemade cakes and hearty hot meals. The comfortable rooms are equipped with a private bathroom and a scenic balcony. The establishment harmoniously combines quality dining with relaxing accommodation. Convenient parking spaces are provided, and the area is ideal for walks and cycling.
